pois.name: Fortim D'El Rei
pois.intro: Fortim d'El Rei is a fort in Mindelo, in the island of São Vicente, Cape Verde. It is located on a hill north of the city centre, in the neighbourhood Fortinho.

pois.name: CNAD - Centro Nacional de Artesanato e Design Mindelo
pois.nameEnglish: CNAD - National Centre for Arts, Craft and Design

pois.name: Statue Cesária Évora;Cesária Évora
pois.intro: Cesária Évora GCIH was a Cape Verdean singer known for singing morna, a genre of music from Cape Verde, in her native Cape Verdean Creole. Her songs were often devoted to themes of love, homesickness, nostalgia, and the history of the Cape Verdean people.

pois.name: Monte Verde
pois.intro: Monte Verde is a mountain in the eastern part of the island of São Vicente, Cape Verde. At 744 m elevation, it is the island's highest point.

pois.name: Monte Cara
pois.intro: Monte Cara is a mountain in western part of the island of São Vicente, Cape Verde. Its elevation is 490 m.

pois.name: CNAD - National Centre for Arts, Craft and Design
Monte de São João
pois.intro: Monte São João is a low mountain in the central part of the island of São Vicente, Cape Verde. Its elevation is 154 m.

pois.name: Praça Nova (Praça Amilcar Cabral)
pois.intro: Praça Amílcar Cabral, also popularly known as Praça Nova, is an important square of the city of Mindelo, São Vicente, Cape Verde. It is located in the northern part of the city center of Mindelo.
